title: Beef with vegetables (no carrots, broccoli, dark‑green leafy greens)

content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of lean beef sautéed with a variety of vegetables, excluding carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens. Instead, sweet pepper, zucchini, tomatoes, onion and garlic are used. It is prepared without potatoes and served with mushroom sauce (1519).

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef is an excellent source of iron, zinc and vitamin B12.
Excluding carrots and broccoli reduces beta‑carotene content, giving the dish a more neutral flavor.
Mushroom sauce (1519) is often made from cream and button mushrooms, providing a creamy texture.
Such vegetable combinations are traditional in Mediterranean cuisine for a light yet satisfying meal.
The lack of potatoes makes the dish lower in carbohydrates, suitable for low‑carb diets.

items.title: High-quality protein
items.content: Beef supplies a complete set of essential amino acids needed for muscle maintenance.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B6 and B12 support nervous system function and red blood cell formation.

items.title: Low carbohydrate content
items.content: Without potatoes or carrots, the dish helps keep blood sugar levels stable.

items.title: Antioxidant properties of mushroom sauce
items.content: Mushrooms contain selenium and polyphenols that combat free radicals.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Zinc from beef and vitamin C from tomatoes contribute to a stronger immune response.

items.title: Saturated fat content
items.content: Choose lean cuts of beef to keep saturated fat intake low.

items.title: Mushroom allergy
items.content: People with known mushroom allergies should avoid the mushroom sauce.

items.title: Sodium in the sauce
items.content: Prepared mushroom sauce can be salty; adjust added salt accordingly.

items.title: Risk of contamination if stored improperly
items.content: Beef should be kept at 4 °C or below and cooked thoroughly.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the beef and vegetables hot, drizzled with mushroom sauce. The dish pairs well with whole‑grain sides, quinoa, or a fresh tomato salad. Garnish with herbs such as parsley or basil if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Cool leftovers in an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze in bags at –18 °C, where it retains quality for up to 2 months. Reheat until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 75 °C.
